AppSubtitle: Download and convert media with yt-dlp
UrlTooltip: Paste a video, playlist or channel URL
UrlPlaceholder: Paste a video, playlist or channel URL...
Title: Title
QueueEmptyHint: Paste a URL above and click "Add to queue". Playlists and channels are listed here with their thumbnails, duration and size.
IncludePlaylistTooltip: When off, only the video from the URL is queued.
CreatePlaylistFolderTooltip: Each playlist is downloaded into a subfolder named after it.
IncludeVideoId: Add the video ID to filenames
IncludeVideoIdTooltip: Useful to avoid collisions between videos with the same title.
CustomFormatTooltip: Optional yt-dlp format expression, e.g. bv*[height<=1080]+ba/b. Leave empty to use the preset above.
EmbedThumbnailTooltip: The cover is embedded in the media file. VLC displays it for audio files; VLC does not show embedded covers for video files, even when the image is present in the file.
WriteThumbnail: Keep a thumbnail file next to the media
WriteThumbnailTooltip: Also saves the thumbnail as a separate image next to the media (useful for Explorer and other players).
LimitRateTooltip: Example: 2000 for about 2 MB/s. Leave empty for no limit.
ProbeSizesTooltip: Asks yt-dlp for the size of each item. For very large channels this can take a while; sizes are also refined while downloading.
AutoCheckUpdates: Check for yt-dlp updates on startup
AutoUpdateAppTooltip: Checks GitHub on startup, downloads the new version, replaces the executable and restarts the app.
InstallAppUpdateTooltip: Download this MediaVacuum version, replace the executable and restart.
AppUpdateBusy: Finish or cancel the current queue before updating MediaVacuum.
OverwriteExistingTooltip: When off, yt-dlp skips files that already exist or have already been downloaded.
FfmpegMissing: ffmpeg was not found. Audio conversion, merging and thumbnail embedding require it.
FfmpegDownloadPrompt: ffmpeg is required for this operation. Download it now? The archive is about 80 MB and will be installed in the MediaVacuum data folder.
FfmpegRequiredPrompt:
This operation requires ffmpeg (audio conversion, merging, thumbnail embedding or container conversion).

Download ffmpeg now?
AlreadyInQueue: These items are already in the queue
InvalidUrl: Please enter a valid http(s) URL.
NoSelection: Select at least one item in the queue.
MenuInstallSuccess: The "Download media" context menu has been installed. Right-click in a folder (or on a folder) and choose "Download media".
MenuRemoveSuccess: The "Download media" context menu has been removed.
MenuInstallFailed: Unable to install the context menu
MenuRemoveFailed: Unable to remove the context menu
UninstallPrompt:
Uninstall MediaVacuum?

This removes the Explorer context menu and, if you confirm, the application data (configuration, yt-dlp, ffmpeg, thumbnails and logs). Your downloads are never deleted.
RemoveAppDataPrompt:
Also delete the MediaVacuum application data (configuration, yt-dlp, ffmpeg, thumbnails and logs)?

Choose No to keep them for a future reinstall.
UninstallComplete: MediaVacuum has been uninstalled. You can close the application; the executable will be removed automatically.
ConfirmClose: A download is still in progress. Cancel it and close the application?
ConfirmClearQueue: Cancel the current downloads and clear the queue?
